note: Scripted B1 samples for the Machine monitor. Each list is the samples POSTed to /control/metrics/script for that machine; B1 advances one sample per machine per tick (core.sample(id) in the preview).

climb.notices: strained: after the 2nd strained reading (sample 3); critical: at sample 4 (replaces the strained row); reminder: only after the reminder interval; withdrawn when the level returns to ok
